profile.Civilian Name: Sylvia Ng; Wú Qiān Zhēn (吴芊蓁)
profile.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology: Software Engineering
profile.Civilian Occupation: Planned — Software Engineer at LumaSoft (Platform Software Engineering — PSE)
profile.Signature Ability: Everlasting Bloom – Flora channels Earth magic into surrounding vegetation, accelerating plant growth and strengthening its vitality. She can create protective formations of flowers, and vines while sustaining damaged plants. Following her evolution, these formations can incorporate controlled warmth and embers.
profile.Strengths: Healing, plant manipulation, battlefield control, adaptability, teamwork, creativity, emotional support, and strategic observation.
profile.Weaknesses: Her protective instincts can cause her to prioritise others over her own safety. Large-scale plant manipulation and sustained healing consume considerable magical energy. Her carefree behaviour may also lead others to underestimate her seriousness.
profile.Fear: Losing someone she could have saved, particularly a disciple or someone under her protection.
profile.Disciple: Luma Aster, Luma Marigold, Luma Lotus; Luma Coffea, Luma Fractal, Luma Clover, Luma Iris are not officially registered.
profile.Relationship: Single; later develops a romantic relationship with Luma Clover (Asher Lim)
profile.Close bonds: Luma Blossom (Lumina), Luma Verdant, members of Wildflowers
profile.Loves: Plants, flowers, nature, her friends, and spending time with the people she cares about.
profile.Likes: Gardening, decorating shared spaces, friendly teasing, group activities, cute accessories, and celebrating small achievements.
profile.Dislikes: Seeing people unnecessarily hurt, excessive restrictions, neglect of living things, and being excluded from important decisions.
profile.Hates: Cruelty towards vulnerable people, deliberate harm to innocent lives, and the abuse of Guardian powers.
profile.Hobbies: Gardening, collecting unusual plants, flower arranging, experimenting with plant care, and trying creative activities with friends.
profile.Catchphrase: “There's always room for something to grow!”
profile.Personality: Sylvia is cheerful, playful, and carefree, with an expressive personality that makes her easy to approach. She enjoys teasing those close to her, sharing her excitement, and occasionally dragging others into spontaneous activities. Despite her energetic and sometimes impulsive behaviour, she is responsible and dependable when situations become serious. As a Guardian, she is compassionate and nurturing, particularly towards her disciples, whom she encourages through patience and positive reinforcement. Her love for plants reflects her caring nature and enjoyment of watching living things grow. Although she frequently jokes around with Blossom, the two share a deep understanding and trust, allowing them to work together exceptionally well. Sylvia openly expresses her affection and concern for others.
Personality Example: Sylvia might excitedly drag Blossom into a trending dance or spontaneous activity, only to complain dramatically when Blossom refuses. However, the moment someone needs help, her playful behaviour gives way to focused determination.

During training, she often encourages disciples through compliments and enthusiastic support. She may joke about their mistakes, but she also makes sure they understand what went wrong and how to improve.
When a plant she has been caring for finally flowers, Sylvia proudly shows it to everyone in the house, regardless of whether they have already seen it several times.
profile.Fever Behaviour: Sylvia becomes noticeably more childish, clingy, and affectionate when feverish. She constantly seeks attention and reassurance, often whining about not receiving enough love or affection, especially from Lumina. She becomes unusually pouty when ignored and may dramatically accuse others of not loving her enough. Despite her exhaustion, she stubbornly refuses to sleep unless she feels sufficiently pampered, often demanding hugs or cuddles before settling down.
profile.Intoxicated Behaviour: Sylvia becomes extremely affectionate, impulsive, and energetic when intoxicated. She frequently clings to those around her, especially Lumina, and dramatically complains about not receiving enough affection. Her excitement often leads to reckless decisions, such as swinging objects above her head or attempting to remove her clothes because she feels too warm. She becomes increasingly pouty when stopped and stubbornly refuses to settle down, often declaring that the party is far from over even when everyone else is exhausted.
profile.Core Idea of character: Born from Earth, reborn through Flame. Luma EmberFlora.
Quotes: “A Guardian isn’t the person who stands above everyone else. We’re supposed to stand beside them.”
“I cannot promise that the world will never fall apart. But while I am here, you will always have somewhere safe to stand.”
profile.Background:
Her abilities are associated with plants, roots, flowers, growth, and healing.
Under Verdant's mentorship, Sylvia learned to use her abilities for protection and recovery rather than relying entirely on offensive strength. Her talent for healing, combined with her ability to assess changing situations, eventually earned her qualifications in both Support and Strategist roles.
Before receiving permission to take disciples, Flora held the Bright Star classification. During a theatre attack on 17 October 2025, Luma Lumen issued an Emergency Discipleship Grant, allowing Flora and Blossom to awaken and protect four new disciples despite their existing restrictions.
Their judgement and successful handling of the incident demonstrated their readiness for mentorship. Following Command's review, both were promoted to Clear Star and officially permitted to take disciples.
During the Graduation Attack, Flora was critically injured while protecting civilians and her newly awakened disciples. Although the four disciples combined their healing abilities, their limited experience allowed them to treat only her physical injuries. Her weakened Earth Core continued to collapse.
To save her, Blossom channelled a controlled portion of her Fire power into Flora's Core, intending to provide temporary stabilisation. Unexpectedly, Flora's Core accepted the foreign element and permanently incorporated it into her existing Earth magic.
This marked her evolution into Luma EmberFlora.
Her plants began developing new properties, including the ability to produce warmth and glowing embers. Rather than abandoning her original nature-based abilities, Flora's inherited Fire became an extension of them.
Following her evolution, Flora continues to serve as a healer, mentor, and trusted member of the Wildflowers. Her relationship with Blossom remains central to her Guardian life, while her growing responsibilities towards their disciples encourage her to develop as both a protector and teacher.
